# Gezel

> Gezel is a free, open-source app and platform for running a crew of AI agents on your own computer, with local models or a cloud plan you already have. Everything on this site is also available as plain markdown.

## Start here

- [Build a Gezel app: the complete guide](https://gezel.com/docs/build-a-gezel-app.md): read this before building a Gezel app. The working loop, the rules, and the four app-building guides in full. `gezel app guide` prints the same page.
- [Build on Gezel](https://gezel.com/platform/): the command line, the app SDK for your own software, and AI Apps that install into Gezel.

## Docs

- [Every Handboek article as markdown](https://gezel.com/docs/llms.txt): the full index, by area.
- [The gezel command line](https://gezel.com/docs/cli-reference.md): every command, for scripts and servers.
- [Model scorecard](https://gezel.com/docs/model-scorecard.md): which local models finish real jobs, and on which hardware.
